lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid of high-intensity circular pixel clusters is visible posterior to the branchial slits, organized into approximately four distinct horizontal rows and twelve vertical columns of varying luminance.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a structured matrix of grid-like anchor nodes across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges extend across the upper flank from the gill region toward the caudal peduncle, each exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal aspect and shadowing on the ventral aspect.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-contrast, sparsely distributed high-luminance blobs are visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily clustered near the anterior base and lower mid-section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The posterior margin of the first dorsal fin exhibits an irregular, jagged silhouette consistent with minor tissue loss or abrasion; a small, high-contrast white elongated object is visible on the mid-lateral surface of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-density concentration of smaller, irregular high-luminance spots that are notably more compressed and less geometrically organized than those on the lateral flank.
